feature: Local first-launch AI connection guidance and sidebar status dialog

behavior.local_opt_in: HWP_LOCAL_AI_SETUP=1 from native loopback launchers; no configured authentication users; current Codex owner only
behavior.probe: initialize, initialized, account/read with refreshToken=false; no thread, turn, login or model call
behavior.choice: codex or later, committed in additive ai_connection_setup table; existing providers/jobs unchanged
behavior.editor: Global dialog leaves current editor and unsaved content mounted

ui_cases: Explicit single-flight check and persisted choice
Compact keyboard navigation, background isolation and defer/reload
Missing CLI, signed-out, timeout and unsupported authentication recovery
Server mode never probes or changes configuration
Late responses ignored and failed setup remains dismissible
Failed initial status leaves library usable and retry recovers
Unsaved mock editor and underlying menu survive open/check/save/Escape

scope_limits: UI automated cases use mocked HTTP and editor; they do not establish real HWPX layout correctness.
Actual installed CLI check establishes saved ChatGPT authentication type, not model entitlement or generation success.
No full regression, new rhwp/Hancom rendering test, Docker rollout or isolated-network verification.
Missing bundled Chromium initially blocked UI startup; final tests used installed Chrome.
Native dialog Tab behavior was diagnosed separately; final assertions verify modal isolation without overriding browser focus behavior.
